title: LOFT: LOCAL PROXY FINE-TUNING FOR IMPROVING TRANSFERABILITY OF ADVERSARIAL ATTACKS AGAINST LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical security aspect of jailbreaking and adversarial attacks on LLMs. While it discusses bypassing 'alignment' and 'harmful content,' it does so from a robustness and security perspective rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
